cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Omega! Three new clients want iPhone apps. Same week.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: And your plan?

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Copy the last app. Change the logo.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: A church, a dentist and a bakery. One app.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: People like sermons.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Okay. The playbook behind our twenty-four apps. It's free. Watch.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Step one. Every app starts from one shell. Zero third-party packages.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Zero? Not even one little package?

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Nothing to update. Nothing to audit. Nothing for you to break.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Step two. One design file per client. Edit it, and the whole app changes.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: So I make everything purple?

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Each client gets a named look. Harvest. Velour. Not purple.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Step three. It pulls what they already post. Videos. Calendars. No server.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Okay. Ship all three tonight. Skip the iPad testing.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: No. One stretched photo can cover the buttons on iPad. Review taps everything.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Has that ever happened to us?

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Once. Now every photo goes through one wrapper.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Omega! The bakery loves their new app!

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Ten points per dollar. Four tiers. Built for a bakery.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: I added a purple mode.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Delete it.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Comment APPS, and I'll send you the repo.
